# In Pursuit of Adventure

> > A cultural travel blog by Ashley & Alex exploring Europe, the Middle East, and beyond through food, history, and authentic local experiences.

This blog chronicles immersive travel adventures with a focus on Italian culture, European historical sites, culinary experiences, and off-the-beaten-path destinations. Features personal narratives, guest posts, and the Sunday Wine Down series exploring food and beverage traditions.

## Key Topics

- Rome
- Italy
- Europe
- Cultural experiences
- Travel photography
- Istanbul
- Paris
- Naples
- Italian cuisine
- Historical sites
- Wine and food culture
- Hagia Sophia
- Pantheon
- Anthony Bourdain
- European architecture

## Essential Travel Guides

- [Tips for Visiting Rome-Part 2](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/01/15/tips-for-visiting-rome-part-2): Rome travel guide covering food, safety, and Trastevere accommodations
- [In Pursuit of Adventure](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com): Homepage for Ashley & Alex's cultural travel blog and adventures

## Hidden Gems & Historical Sites

- [My Favorite Underground Site in Europe](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/08/16/my-favorite-underground-site): Basilica Cistern in Istanbul: hauntingly beautiful Byzantine site
- [The Basilica di San Clemente, More Than Just a Church](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2015/02/05/the-basilica-di-san-clemente-more-than-just-a-church): Multi-level Basilica di San Clemente: hidden archaeological gem in Rome
- [A Glimpse of Villa d'Este](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/09/21/a-glimpse-of-villa-deste): Renaissance Villa d'Este fountains and gardens in Tivoli near Rome
- [5 Reasons Why I Love Versailles](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/03/29/5-reasons-why-i-love-versailles): Visual tour of Versailles Palace and Marie Antoinette's Petit Trianon

## Cultural Immersion & Local Experiences

- [A Bath to Remember](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/09/18/a-bath-to-remember): First-hand Turkish hammam experience in Istanbul's Golden Horn area
- [A Few Hours with Gadhafi](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/09/25/a-few-hours-with-gadhafi): Pre-revolution Tripoli airport experience during Gadhafi era in Libya
- [Angkor Wat in Black & White](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/11/26/angkor-wat-in-black-white): Black and white photography of Angkor Wat temple ruins in Cambodia
- [Do You Like Rabbit?](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/10/17/do-you-like-rabbit): Travel story navigating Naples with guide Mario in southern Italy

## Food & Wine Adventures

- [48 Hours Eating Our Way Through Portland](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/10/11/48-hours-eating-our-way-through-portland): Portland food guide featuring Toro Bravo and Pacific Northwest cuisine
- [5 Reasons Why I Love Gelato](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/03/24/5-reasons-why-i-love-gelato): Rome gelato guide featuring San Crispino and Frigidarium shops
- [The Wild Side of Wine](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/02/11/the-wild-side-of-wine): Guest post by Rory on wine tasting experiences from Perth to Rome
- [Sunday Wine Down Holiday Special: Eggnog](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/12/28/sunday-wine-down-holiday-special-eggnog): Holiday special on eggnog history from North America to Europe

## European City Explorations

- [5 Reasons Why I Love Italian Beaches](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/05/22/5-reasons-why-i-love-italian-beaches): Italian beach culture from Sorrento to Sperlonga and Cinque Terre
- [A Glimpse of Milan](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/04/13/a-glimpse-of-milan): Brief Milan visit featuring The Duomo, Galleria, and Castle
- [Two Nights in the City of Lights](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2014/03/06/two-nights-in-the-city-of-lights): Guest post by Adrian and Zoe on weekend trip to Paris
- [Back to My Roots](https://inpursuitofadventureblog.wordpress.com/2013/08/15/back-to-my-roots): Sister Amber's wedding in hometown Pismo Beach, California
